controls.columns_shuffled: not applicable (genes are identified by id; causalbench's own split and preprocessing)
controls.supplier: CausalBench (GSK) K562 and RPE1 single-cell knockdown data, preprocessed bit-identically to causalbench 1.1.2 (analysis/ben13/stream_preprocess.py)
controls.names_note: data-only methods (MeanDifference, random, rewired, permuted) never read gene names; the literature networks are names-only predictions

metric_defs.wasserstein: causalbench statistical Evaluator: mean Wasserstein distance over the output network's edges, on the 20 % test split
metric_defs.for: false omission rate over 500 sampled negative pairs outside the network's path closure (random.seed(0)); None when fewer than 500 exist
metric_defs.biological_precision: causalbench biological Evaluator per literature set (undirected true positives)

orientation_rule: causalbench's: a predicted edge (parent, child) is scored by the child's shift under the parent's knockdown; no undirected predictions exist
